resources.string: Collect a privacy-safe compatibility report for a Triumph motorcycle in one bounded diagnostic session.
If it is not listed, power it from the motorcycle and pair it in Android Bluetooth settings using PIN 1234.
The app always saves all read evidence first. Select either test to continue in the same connection.
Test service reset, then restore (km mode)
The motorcycle does not expose these stored values to the app. Enter the exact current interval and date: the test writes +100 km and +1 day, then writes these original values back.
Temporary test: %1$d km, %2$s. Then restore the entered values.

These tests change stored motorcycle data. DTC clear erases diagnostic evidence. Service restoration is attempted after success or an explicit rejection, but cannot be guaranteed after disconnect, timeout, or an ambiguous write.
I understand and want to run the selected writes once.
Candidate means the known Triumph read path matched. A write result is shown only when that test was explicitly selected.

The app never requests VIN or serial data. Optional writes are limited to the exact observed SecurityAccess/DTC-clear and kilometre service-reset sequences, run once after all reads and stopped on mismatch or an ambiguous response.
Unofficial research tool. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Triumph Motorcycles.
